title: cerinthe glabra subsp. tenuiflora
intro: Cerinthe glabra subsp. tenuiflora, commonly known as blue shrimp plant or blue eyes, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). The health benefits of Cerinthe glabra subsp. tenuiflora include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that may exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. These bioactive constituents are believed to contribute to the plant's ability to soothe and protect the body, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues.
